parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-32, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQQH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-32, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-32 (Area T)**

Vertical electrical sounding (VES) at Station T-32 reveals a 6-layer geoelectric sequence:
- **Layer 1** (0–18.51 m): Overburden (184.7 Ω·m)
- **Layer 2** (18.51–19.28 m): Thin resistive unit (735.3 Ω·m)
- **Layer 3** (19.28–21.55 m): Intermediate layer (503.9 Ω·m)
- **Layer 4** (21.55–55.24 m): Conductive weathered zone (56.6 Ω·m)
- **Layer 5** (55.24–61.14 m): Primary conductive aquifer zone (43.3 Ω·m)
- **Layer 6** (>61.14 m): Resistive bedrock (520.0 Ω·m)

The consecutive 3-layer relationships (K: 1-2-3, Q: 2-3-4, Q: 3-4-5, H: 4-5-6) confirm the curve classification is **KQQH**, which accurately matches the classification on file. Recommended drilling target is the conductive interval from 21.5 m to 61.1 m before encountering hard basement.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQQH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
